messages:
Anna L: Starting the staged rollout to v2.0.0 at 20% -> 50% window, change window ends 23:45 PT. Deploy notes: small inferred-model tweak, no schema changes.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: rollout v2.0.0. Phase: increase traffic 20% -> 50% (target groups: global except ap-south). ETA 7m. 
Mike R: seeing a small uptick in EU edge 5xxs right as we bumped to 35%. 0.2% -> 1.6% over last 3m. tagging ops.
Sara K: thanks — can you paste the query? is it specific to a model variant or routing rule?
Mike R: looks like requests hitting eu-west edge with model variant v2.0.0-quant. 5xxs are timeouts from runtime; tail latency spiking.
Charlie: Paging oncall to hold the traffic shift if signal persists. Ops, can we hold at current %? :eyes: 
ops-oncall: Holding forward traffic increase. Rollout paused at 35%. Reason: eu-west 5xx spike and increased p95.
Lina P: Can we isolate by route? If it's only embed route, we can pin generation to v1 just for that route.
Anna L: Good idea. Quick check: can we rollback region-only or do a full rollback?
ops-oncall: We have targeted routing. We can pin eu-west to previous model revision v1.9 for now. That will avoid global rollback.
Sara K: I support region pin. Also posting release note update: "EU pinned to v1.9 due to latency spike during staged rollout; investigating kernel path for quant variant."
deploy-bot: Suggested command: `/deploy switch-rollout --region eu-west --to v1.9 --retain-traffic 35%`
Mike R: ran a quick tail: errors show `kvcache OOM` logs on node gw-12 in eu-west-3. Could be warmup threshold for the new quant kernels.
Charlie: ops, any capacity autoscale events?
ops-oncall: No autoscale failures, but gw-12 shows memory pressure + many small warmup execs. We'll pin and cordon node with maintenance label.
Lina P: Who can take follow-up? I can own an exploratory repro with smaller batch sizes and kvprefetch off.
Anna L: Lina own repro. Mike dig deeper into logs/kernels. Sara update the release notes and add a rollback block in the change window doc.
Sara K: Done — updated release notes and added a rollback checklist. Also added a note to change window: "if region pin occurs, postpone further increases until morning bake."
Mike R: after pin, 5xxs decaying back to baseline within 4m. p95 still elevated a bit.
ops-oncall: Confirmed: eu-west traffic pinned to v1.9. Rollout remains paused. No global rollback.
Anna L: Stop/go call — quick vote: Resume increase to 50% once Lina's repro validates config or we hold until morning? React with :thumbsup: to resume tonight, :hand: to hold until AM.
Charlie: :hand: (hold until AM)
Lina P: :hand: (hold) want to validate repro first
Mike R: :hand: leaning hold — want to confirm kvcache param fixes
Sara K: :hand: hold and note in release notes
Anna L: Consensus to hold. I'll file a short incident note and schedule a morning follow-up with infra team. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 35%. Region eu-west pinned to v1.9. Actions logged: #INC-2026-045.
ops-oncall: We'll cordon gw-12 and spin a warmup-only pool for testing. Ping me if you need immediate access.
Anna L: Great work — closing this stop/go. We'll reopen when Lina confirms repro and we have a mitigation plan. :white_check_mark:
